## Frequently Asked Questions
Expand AllCollapse All

Can I get a demo of Bigin?

Do I need to provide my credit card information to start a trial?

No, we do not ask for your credit card for the trial. Even after your free trial ends, you can continue using our forever free plan.

Will I be charged automatically?

No, you won't be charged automatically. You will be moved to the Free plan.

What is the difference between Express, Premier, and Free plans especially regarding user limits and record limits?

The Free plan allows only 1 user. Express and Premier have no user limits, and you will be charged per user license. The Free plan allows you to store up to 500 records. Express supports 50,000 records, Premier supports 100,000 records, and Bigin 360 supports 1 million records. You can refer to the full limits and details on the [Bigin pricing page.](https://www.bigin.com/pricing.html?source_from=biginpricing)

What is a "record" in Bigin, and how are records counted in each plan?

A new row of information added to any of the following modules is considered a record in Bigin: Contacts, Companies, Pipelines, Activities, Products, and Notes. For more details, refer to our [help doc.](https://help.zoho.com/portal/en/kb/bigin/data-administration/articles/record-storage-settings#What_is_a_record_in_Bigin)

Who can I speak to for more information on pricing and subscription plans?

You can contact the Bigin sales team at [sales@bigin.com](mailto:sales@bigin.com) for details on pricing and subscriptions. You can also reach us via a toll-free number; please check our [contact page](https://www.bigin.com/contact-us.html?source_from=biginpricing) for numbers

How can I pay?

We accept payments via Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and PayPal. We also accept payments via bank transfer and check transfer for annual subscriptions. For more details, please contact [sales@bigin.com](mailto:sales@bigin.com)

Spreadsheets are usually free. Why should I upgrade to a paid CRM software?

We understand your concern about moving from a free solution to a paid one. Bigin offers key advantages like automated workflows, better customer data organization, and improved team collaboration.

Can I add more users or upgrade/downgrade my plan at any time?

Can I get my money back if I'm not satisfied?

How can I migrate my data from another CRM into Bigin? Is there support for this?

We support single-click migration from Pipedrive, HubSpot, Insightly, and Zoho CRM. For other CRMs, you can import data using CSV files, and our support team can assist if required.

Can I integrate Bigin with other Zoho apps (like Zoho Books or Zoho CRM) and third-party tools?

Yes, Bigin connects with Zoho apps like Zoho Books and with popular third-party tools.

Is Bigin included in Zoho One?

Yes. If you're a Zoho One user, you have full access to Bigin. Simply launch Bigin from your Zoho One admin panel to get started.

Is it possible to upgrade to Zoho CRM when I outgrow Bigin?

Yes, you can easily upgrade to Zoho CRM with one-click data migration.

How is Bigin different from Zoho CRM?

It depends on what features you're looking for.

What post-purchase assistance is offered by the Bigin team?

We offer a standard 30-day onboarding period with phone, live chat, and email support. For dedicated implementation, visit our [Jumpstart](https://www.bigin.com/jumpstart.html?source_from=biginpricing) page.

What languages is Bigin available in?

What if I have more questions?

Please drop us an email at [sales@bigin.com](mailto:sales@bigin.com) and we'll be happy to assist.

See more

Please email us at [support@bigin.com](mailto:support@bigin.com) for more information.

- Downgrading your plan is typically prohibited until your contract renewal date.

- Free trials available

- Lock-In

- Absolutely no lock-in.

You have the freedom to upgrade, downgrade, or cancel whenever your business needs change.

- Most vendors lock you into annual contracts with steep fees for early cancellation. Downgrades are often prohibited mid-term.

Yes, absolutely. [Please fill out this form](https://www.bigin.com/request-demo.html?source_from=biginpricing) and our team will be in touch with you to arrange a personalized demo at a convenient time for you.

Do I need to provide my credit card information to start a trial?

No, we do not ask for your credit card for the trial. Even after your free trial ends, you can continue using our forever free plan.

What happens after the 15-day trial? Will I be charged automatically?

No, you won't be charged automatically. You will be moved to the Free plan.

What is the difference between Express, Premier, and Free plans especially regarding user limits and record limits?

The Free plan allows only 1 user. Express and Premier have no user limits, and you will be charged per user license. The Free plan allows you to store up to 500 records. Express supports 50,000 records, Premier supports 100,000 records, and Bigin 360 supports 1 million records. You can refer to the full limits and details on the [Bigin pricing page.](https://www.bigin.com/pricing.html?source_from=biginpricing)

What is a "record" in Bigin, and how are records counted in each plan?

A new row of information added to any of the following modules is considered a record in Bigin: Contacts, Companies, Pipelines, Activities, Products, and Notes. For more details, refer to our [help doc.](https://help.zoho.com/portal/en/kb/bigin/data-administration/articles/record-storage-settings#What_is_a_record_in_Bigin)

Who can I speak to for more information on pricing and subscription plans?

You can contact the Bigin sales team at [sales@bigin.com](mailto:sales@bigin.com) for details on pricing and subscriptions. You can also reach us via a toll-free number; please check our [contact page](https://www.bigin.com/contact-us.html?source_from=biginpricing) for numbers

How can I pay?

We accept payments via Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and PayPal. We also accept payments via bank transfer and check transfer for annual subscriptions. For more details, please contact [sales@bigin.com](mailto:sales@bigin.com)

Spreadsheets are usually free. Why should I upgrade to a paid CRM software?

We understand your concern about moving from a free solution to a paid one. That's exactly why we've developed a [CRM ROI calculator](https://www.bigin.com/bigin-roi-calculator.html?source_from=biginpricing) – to help you see the actual value you'll get from the investment. Bigin offers key advantages like automated workflows, better customer data organization, and improved team collaboration.

Can I add more users or upgrade/downgrade my plan at any time?

Yes, you can add users or change your plan whenever you need.

Can I get my money back if I'm not satisfied?

If at any time during your first 30 days (for monthly subscriptions) or 45 days (for annual subscriptions), you're not satisfied with our product or service, we will gladly offer you a full refund and downgrade your account to the free plan.

How can I migrate my data from another CRM into Bigin? Is there support for this?

We support single-click migration from Pipedrive, HubSpot, Insightly, and Zoho CRM. For other CRMs, you can import data using CSV files, and our support team can assist if required.

Can I integrate Bigin with other Zoho apps (like Zoho Books or Zoho CRM) and third-party tools?

Yes, Bigin connects with Zoho apps like Zoho Books and with popular third-party tools.

Is Bigin included in Zoho One?

Yes. If you're a Zoho One user, you have full access to Bigin. Simply launch Bigin from your Zoho One admin panel to get started.

Is it possible to upgrade to Zoho CRM when I outgrow Bigin?

Yes, you can easily upgrade to Zoho CRM with one-click data migration.

How is Bigin different from Zoho CRM?

It depends on what features you're looking for. We've put together a [comparison guide](https://www.bigin.com/compare-zohocrm-editions.html?source_from=biginpricing).

What post-purchase assistance is offered by the Bigin team?

We offer a standard 30-day onboarding period with phone, live chat, and email support. For dedicated implementation, visit our [Jumpstart](https://www.bigin.com/jumpstart.html?source_from=biginpricing) page.

What languages is Bigin available in?

Bigin is available in 28 languages: Bahasa Indonesia, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Danish, German, English (UK), English (US), Spanish, French, Croatian, Italian, Hungarian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese (Portugal), Swedish, Vietnamese, Turkish, Czech, Bulgarian, Russian, Hebrew, Arabic (Egypt), Hindi, Thai, Japanese, and Korean.

What if I have more questions?

Please drop us an email at [sales@bigin.com](mailto:sales@bigin.com) and we'll be happy to assist.

See more

Can I get a demo of Zoho CRM?

Is my data safe?

We’re fervent about keeping your data safe and secure. Our facilities feature stringent 24/7/365 security with video monitoring, biometric access, and advanced fire, flood, and theft monitoring systems. Our network security system employs the latest encryption and intrusion detection and prevention technologies.

What types of payment do you accept?

We accept payment via Visa, MasterCard, American Express and PayPal. We also accept payment via bank transfer or check transfer for yearly subscriptions. For more details, please contact [sales@zohocorp.com.](mailto:sales@zohocorp.com)

How flexible are your contracts?

You are not bound by any contracts or commitments. Zoho CRM is a pay-as-you-go service (monthly or yearly), so you can make changes to your plan whenever you need to.

Can I switch plans?

Of course you can! Log in to Zoho CRM, click the Upgrade link on the Home page, and follow the steps on the Subscription page to switch to a new plan.

How do you support businesses signing up for Zoho CRM?

For customers of our paid editions, you automatically have access to our Classic support. You also have the option to opt-in for one of our paid support plans that promises faster responses, round the clock support, dedicated on-boarding and more. [Explore support plans](https://www.zoho.com/crm/support-plans.html?source_from=crmpricing)

Do you provide any assistance in getting Zoho CRM set up and running for our business?

Yes, we do have end-to-end services that cover everything from requirement gathering to setup and onboarding. We have dedicated programs for SMEs and Enterprises, so that the different requirements and needs are addressed effectively.

[Explore Jumpstart](https://www.zoho.com/jumpstart/?source_from=crmpricing) [Explore Zoho EBS](https://www.zoho.com/enterprise/ebs/?source_from=crmpricing)

Are there any other editions in Zoho CRM?

Yes, Zoho CRM has an Ultimate edition tailored for large-scale, bespoke deployments with highest possible feature limits, consultation with experts, and migration assistance.

Does Zoho CRM have a free edition?

Yes, Zoho CRM does have free edition that supports upto 3 users and comes with the essentials like leads, documents, and mobile apps, it’s a perfect fit for your home business. [Get started here](https://www.zoho.com/crm/signup.html?plan=free&source_from=crmpricing)

Have more questions?

You can connect with us instantly through live chat (24x5) or by writing to us at [sales@zohocorp.com.](mailto:sales@zohocorp.com)
